method: read the shipped packages under app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai with the desktop executable as node, then drive the isolated web profile the same way its own browser client does

entry_points_found.cli: no session subcommands: the launcher offers only profile booting, --patch, plugin, rescue and tui --resume
entry_points_found.no_compact_or_clear_method: the controller exposes no compact or clear method; there is nothing to call for either operation at that layer
entry_points_found.command_run_is_an_event_not_an_endpoint: 'command/run' appears as a session EVENT type pairing with 'command/done', not as an RPC
entry_points_found.how_a_slash_command_is_executed: @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands parses a leading /name out of user input and executes the command without sending it to the model, so a person reaches compact by typing it into a session - the browser does that through session/prompt
entry_points_found.clear: the build inspection did not find a dsh-command-clear package or a usable clear entry point; absence of that package name alone does not prove that every surface lacks an equivalent operation

session_fork.call: session/fork {request:{sessionId:<target>}} through the web profile's own client path
session_fork.reading: fork is drivable on this surface: a real, distinct child conversation was produced from the target. Its Tsunagou enrollment state was NOT observed, because that needs a model turn in the child and the prompt call below did not accept a request.

session_prompt_for_compact.outcome: every shape was refused at the gateway boundary: 'session/prompt: wire field "request" failed boundary validation', details.field = request, with no inner field named
session_prompt_for_compact.consequence: /compact could not be typed into the target conversation, and no model turn was produced in it either. compact remains not executed; this is a shape-matching failure of the probe, not a host refusal of compaction.

not_executed.compact: the surface offers it as a typed command; the probe could not deliver user input to the target session
not_executed.clear: no usable clear entry point was found during this review - kept as an untested gap, and 'new' was NOT substituted for it
not_executed.identity_after_compact: needs a model turn in the target session, which needs the same prompt call
not_executed.identity_in_the_fork: needs a model turn in the child session

observation_about_the_fork_surface: The web profile was launched with the worker conversation's overlay. The shared MCP configuration and the established R1 counterexample imply a risk of reusing the worker identity; this is an inference, not an observed Tsunagou call from the child. The child's Tsunagou identity remains unobserved, so successful host-side fork is not identity-continuity evidence.
stopped_because: the remaining obstacle is the probe's own request shape, and the scope forbids building more machinery
